_comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, so the +1{p} never applied. Its condition was CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE with token_type 'ITEM_OR_EQUIPMENT' -- an invented token type, and controlling a token has nothing to do with what boosting banished. 'If an item or equipment was BANISHED FROM BOOSTING this' asks about the banished card's TYPE, which CARD_WAS_BOOSTED cannot answer either: it says only that a boost happened. boost() now records what it banished on the card it boosted, and the pump is a WHILE_STATIC on the attack-power recalculation, confined to this card's own attack by SOURCE_IS_ATTACK.
